get.description: Operational status for the platform admin console (real checks, no hard-coded values).
Effective switches for client UX. Informational only: the server re-checks on every location request.

post.description: Inserts the previewed valid rows. Safe to retry: a committed job returns its original result; conflicts are skipped, never overwritten.
dry_run=true (default) computes and returns a proposal without persisting anything. dry_run=false persists PROPOSED allocations.

get.description: Replacement-driver search: eligible drivers (leave, licence, shift, slot conflicts applied), fairest first, with score explanations.

post.description:
Creates the incident immediately. An optional inline `location` is evaluated against the switches; absent/denied/disabled
location never blocks the alert. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the original incident (no duplicate alert).

get.description: Lists incidents WITHOUT coordinates. Non-staff see only incidents they raised / (drivers) on their own trips (RLS).

put.description: Second step: the client alerts first, then sends the fix (or denied/unavailable) when the device returns it.

delete.description: Safe deletion: removes coordinates early (retention purge also does this automatically). The incident record remains.

get.description: Staff-only detail including coordinates. Every read of coordinates is audit-logged.
What the client needs to decide whether to ask for GPS at all (drivers) or show a map (staff/employees).
Current position of every vehicle on an in-progress trip (staff only).
Passenger view of their own cab. Only when live tracking is effective AND the organization allowed employee view.
The employee's own 4-digit code for this trip. Show it to the driver when boarding.

post.description: Dispatcher override when the employee cannot show a code (dead phone etc.). Always audited with a reason.

get.description: Driver: QR payload for passengers to scan. Valid for 60 s; the app should refresh it about every 45 s.

post.description: Passenger: scan the driver's trip QR to mark yourself boarded.

get.description: One row per active route with coverage counts for the date, plus cabs that belong to no route.
Public: lets the join page say who invited the person. Reveals only organisation, role and first name.
Dashboard numbers straight from the database (today in the organization's timezone).
